newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank 1-week rev repo ave yield 15.98 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank 1-week rev repo ave yield 15.98 pct.

text.p: Average yield at the Czech central bank's (CNB) one-week reverse repo tender to drain market liquidity on Tuesday hit 15.98 percent, the CNB said.
It said all bids at the maximum rate of 16 percent, down from 16.2 percent in a similar operation on Monday, were satisfied. Average yield in Monday's tender was 16.19 percent.
The CNB does not reveal the amount of funds it drains in its open market operations. -- Prague Newsroom, 420-2-2423-0003
